name: Uppsala University
summary: Founded in 1477, with 50,000 students; English bachelor's in Uppsala and on Campus Gotland in Visby, four in game design.

ib.text: No IB page of its own; the national rules apply. A full IB Diploma gives general entry, and IB English meets English 6. Subjects count at grade 4 (3 at HL Biology, Chemistry, Physics).

programmes.name: Bachelor's Programme in Egyptology
programmes.ib: IB History at grade 4. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.
programmes.about: The material culture, archaeology and texts of ancient Egypt, learning to read ancient Egyptian, combined with Assyriology to set Egypt among the cultures of the Near East.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your IB converted to Sweden's scale (max 22.5), some on the SweSAT; UHR gives no 2026 numeric minimum. 2027 criteria not yet published.

programmes.name: Bachelor's Programme in Energy Transition – Sustainability and Leadership
programmes.ib: Maths AA at grade 3, or AI at 4 (AI HL at 3); plus ESS SL, or two of Biology, Chemistry and Physics. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.
programmes.about: Several disciplines brought together to tackle energy transitions, climate and energy security, with training to lead change towards a sustainable energy system, on Campus Gotland.

needs.note: AI SL at grade 4 also counts.

notes: No Uppsala programme page shows an autumn 2027 intake yet (its pages still say autumn 2026), so the subject rules here are 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

Uppsala urges international students to apply in January, which you cannot while still at school; in 2026 all eight also ran in the April round (e.g. UU-P5370), but no 2027 round of either kind is published yet.
Uppsala's Global English Studies bachelor's is not listed: its page says it requires knowledge of Swedish.
